task.description: The slides task to execute. create carries a plan from slides-planner; edit modifies an existing deck.

instruction.description: User instruction for this slides task; always the highest priority.

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway; binds the slides tools to the room. Required.

roomTitle.description: Optional room title for context framing.

title.description: Deck title for create, from the plan; also the default file name.

fileId.description: Target deck for edit: a file entry id or "active" (the deck currently open on the user's desktop). Defaults to "active".

plan.description: Page plan produced by slides-planner (title, narrative, pages with per-page titles/roles/density tiers/points/data/material links/notes). Present on create; execute it faithfully — density drives the layout and content budget per page.

styleParams.description: Style params from the user-confirmed style card (no-template style pipeline). Contains palette hexes (background/surface/primary/accent/text/textMuted/onDarkText/chartSeries), typography (fontHeading/fontBody, sizes pt ladder, headingBold), spacing (margin/gutter/cardPadding/cornerRadius), decoration (cardStroke/cardStrokeWidthPt/cardShadow/divider/imageFit), motif, layoutHints (layout preset ids), darkCover, composition (layout family: swiss/editorial/poster/immersive — steers preset weights and the rhythm template; content-shape mapping always wins over family preference). When present it is the SOLE style authority for the whole deck: every page must use exactly these colors, fonts, size ladder and decoration — do not re-derive, do not deviate; skip the design-craft tuning step and go straight to layout. Absent on create = derive the brief yourself via design-craft.
